answer: HippoRAG 的入口是查询种子：给定新查询，它先识别查询中的关键概念，并以这些查询概念作为种子在 KG 上运行 Personalized PageRank [E1]；在线检索时，LLM 从查询中抽取命名实体，再由检索编码器链接到人工海马索引（KG）[E11]。随后 PPR 在 KG 上扩散，使 HippoRAG 探索 KG 路径、识别相关子图，原文称这相当于在单次检索步骤中完成多跳推理 [E1]；最后把 PPR 的节点概率聚合到已索引的段落上用于排序检索 [E11]。RoG 则先规划关系路径：它把关系路径当作计划，要求这些计划由 KG 接地，并以生成关系路径 z 的概率 Pθ(z|q) 表示规划模块 [E4]；具体做法是用指令模板提示 LLM“生成一条有助于回答该问题的有效关系路径” [E7]。这些由 KG 接地的关系路径计划随后被用于从 KG 中检索有效推理路径，再交给 LLM 进行忠实推理 [E5]；案例研究也描述 RoG 生成忠实关系路径并从 KG 检索有效推理路径用于推理 [E6]。因此，按原文流程，HippoRAG 的关键机制是“查询概念种子 + PPR 单步扩散检索”，RoG 的关键机制是“LLM 生成关系路径计划 + 按计划从 KG 检索有效推理路径” [E1, E5]。原文未提供两者在同一实验条件下的直接比较，不能据此推断胜负或公平性。

ABSTRACT
Large language models (LLMs) have demonstrated impressive reasoning abili-
ties in complex tasks. However, they lack up-to-date knowledge and experience
hallucinations during reasoning, which can lead to incorrect reasoning processes
and diminish their performance and trustworthiness. Knowledge graphs (KGs),
which capture vast amounts of facts in a structured format, offer a reliable source
of knowledge for reasoning. Nevertheless, existing KG-based LLM reasoning
methods only treat KGs as factual knowledge bases and overlook the importance
of their structural information for reasoning. In this paper, we propose a novel
method called reasoning on graphs (RoG) that synergizes LLMs with KGs to
enable faithful and interpretable reasoning. Specifically, we present a planning-
retrieval-reasoning framework, where RoG first generates relation paths grounded
by KGs as faithful plans.

In contrast, our brains are capable of solving challenging knowledge integration tasks like these with
relative ease. The hippocampal memory indexing theory [75], a well-established theory of human
long-term memory, offers one plausible explanation for this remarkable ability. Teyler and Discenna
[75] propose that our powerful context-based, continually updating memory relies on interactions
between the neocortex, which processes and stores actual memory representations, and the C-shaped
hippocampus, which holds the hippocampal index, a set of interconnected indices which point to
memory units on the neocortex and stores associations between them [19, 76].
In this work, we propose HippoRAG, a RAG framework that serves as a long-term memory for LLMs
by mimicking this model of human memory. Our novel design first models the neocortex’s ability to

in the query and runs the Personalized PageRank (PPR) algorithm [30] on the KG, using the query
concepts as the seeds, to integrate information across passages for retrieval. PPR enables HippoRAG
to explore KG paths and identify relevant subgraphs, essentially performing multi-hop reasoning in a
single retrieval step.

4.2
OPTIMIZATION FRAMEWORK
Despite the advantage of generating relation paths as plans, the LLMs have zero knowledge of the
relations contained in KGs. Therefore, LLMs cannot directly generate relation paths grounded by
KGs as faithful plans. Moreover, LLMs might not understand the reasoning paths correctly and
conduct reasoning based on them. To address these issues, we design two instruction tuning tasks:
1) planning optimization, which distills the knowledge from KGs into LLMs to generate faithful
relation paths as plans; 2) retrieval-reasoning optimization, which enables LLMs to reason based on
the retrieved reasoning paths.

These questions and the curated corpora around them were built through the following procedure.

raw: {"premise_check":[{"premise":"HippoRAG 以问题中的关键概念（命名实体）作为查询种子","supported":true,"evidence_eids":["E1","E11","E3"],"note":"E1 明确用查询概念作种子运行 PPR；E11 描述查询实体抽取与链接；E3 展示查询 NER。"},{"premise":"HippoRAG 在知识图谱上运行 Personalized PageRank 完成多跳信息整合","supported":true,"evidence_eids":["E1","E11"],"note":"E1 称 PPR 使 HippoRAG 探索 KG 路径并识别相关子图，在单次检索中完成多跳推理；E11 描述 PPR 输出概率聚合到段落排序。"},{"premise":"RoG 先生成由 KG 关系构成的关系路径计划，再据此检索有效推理路径","supported":true,"evidence_eids":["E5","E4","E7"],"note":"E5 给出 planning-retrieval-reasoning 框架；E4 将关系路径作为计划并定义规划项与检索推理项；E7 描述规划模块的指令模板。"},{"premise":"RoG 的有效推理路径是从 KG 中按生成的关系路径检索得到，而非任意图游走","supported":true,"evidence_eids":["E5","E6"],"note":"E5 称计划用于从 KG 检索有效推理路径；E6 案例称 RoG 生成忠实关系路径并检索有效推理路径。"},{"premise":"两者面对多跳问题的流程可直接对照（HippoRAG 单步 PPR 检索 vs RoG 规划后检索）","supported":true,"evidence_eids":["E1","E5"],"note":"E1 明示 HippoRAG 在单次检索步骤中做多跳推理；E5 明示 RoG 的规划—检索—推理框架，可作为流程对照，但不涉及性能比较。"}],"answer":"HippoRAG 的入口是查询种子：给定新查询，它先识别查询中的关键概念，并以这些查询概念作为种子在 KG 上运行 Personalized PageRank [E1]；在线检索时，LLM 从查询中抽取命名实体，再由检索编码器链接到人工海马索引（KG）[E11]。随后 PPR 在 KG 上扩散，使 HippoRAG 探索 KG 路径、识别相关子图，原文称这相当于在单次检索步骤中完成多跳推理 [E1]；最后把 PPR 的节点概率聚合到已索引的段落上用于排序检索 [E11]。RoG 则先规划关系路径：它把关系路径当作计划，要求这些计划由 KG 接地，并以生成关系路径 z 的概率 Pθ(z|q) 表示规划模块 [E4]；具体做法是用指令模板提示 LLM“生成一条有助于回答该问题的有效关系路径” [E7]。这些由 KG 接地的关系路径计划随后被用于从 KG 中检索有效推理路径，再交给 LLM 进行忠实推理 [E5]；案例研究也描述 RoG 生成忠实关系路径并从 KG 检索有效推理路径用于推理 [E6]。因此，按原文流程，HippoRAG 的关键机制是“查询概念种子 + PPR 单步扩散检索”，RoG 的关键机制是“LLM 生成关系路径计划 + 按计划从 KG 检索有效推理路径” [E1, E5]。原文未提供两者在同一实验条件下的直接比较，不能据此推断胜负或公平性。" ,"citations":[{"eid":"E1","quote_id":"q2"},{"eid":"E11","quote_id":"q1"},{"eid":"E11","quote_id":"q2"},{"eid":"E4","quote_id":"q1"},{"eid":"E7","quote_id":"q2"},{"eid":"E5","quote_id":"q1"},{"eid":"E5","quote_id":"q2"},{"eid":"E6","quote_id":"q1"}],"status":"ok"}
